title: False memories: subjective and objective responses to an "accented" voice assistant.
summary: The default accent of voice assistants tends to be a standard variety of a language, and commentary around creating voice assistants (VAs) suggests that more regionally marked dialects are avoided for their more marked social associations and their (assumed) reduced intelligibility. In our study, participants "user-tested" two VAs, one with a Southern US English accent, and one with a Mainstream US English accent. Northern US participants evaluated the Southern VA more negatively and commented that she was harder to understand. On the other hand, Southern participants had mixed valence affective reactions to the Southern VA and International participants demonstrated no strong social associations with either accent, and both groups rarely mentioned intelligibility of either VA. Additionally, in a listening game (a short version of the DRM false memory paradigm), there were no significant effects of VA accent on real or false memories for any of the three participant groups. Our results add to work suggesting that while linguistic variation can lead to challenges in communication, intelligibility is often invoked too easily as a reason for exclusion. The potential benefits of and problems around expanding variation in the voices of voice assistants are also discussed.

标题：虚假记忆：对“带口音”语音助手的主观与客观反应
摘要：语音助手的默认口音通常倾向于语言的标准变体，而关于创建语音助手（VAs）的讨论表明，更具地域标记性的方言因其更显著的社会关联及其（假定的）较低可懂度而被回避。在我们的研究中，参与者对两款语音助手进行了“用户测试”，一款带有美国南部英语口音，另一款带有美国主流英语口音。美国北部参与者对南部口音语音助手的评价更为负面，并评论称其更难理解。另一方面，美国南部参与者对南部口音语音助手表现出混合的情感效价反应，而国际参与者则对任一-口音均未表现出强烈的社会关联，且这两组参与者很少提及任一语音助手的可懂度。此外，在一项听力游戏（DRM虚假记忆范式的短版本）中，语音助手口音对三组参与者的真实记忆或虚假记忆均无显著影响。我们的结果进一步支持了以下观点：尽管语言变异可能导致沟通挑战，但可懂度往往被过于轻易地用作排斥的理由。本文还讨论了扩展语音助手声音变异的潜在益处与问题。
关键词：虚假记忆；语音助手；口音；情感反应；社会认知
